_comment: Hand-written. One entry per third-party item that ships in a release (binary or file). 'licence_files' are repo paths whose text is copied verbatim into THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt by scripts/gen_third_party_notices.py. Never write a licence text here: if the repo has no licence file, leave licence_files empty and the generator writes 'licence text missing: owner to supply'. 'copyright' is only what the repo itself states. Regenerate: python3 scripts/gen_third_party_notices.py ; check: --check.

items.name: Dear ImGui (docking branch)
items.copyright: not stated in the repository (the library is downloaded at configure time, not vendored)
items.note: Licence per docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. No licence file for it is in the repository.

items.name: ufbx
items.licence: MIT or public domain (the licence file offers both; the owner has not yet recorded which is chosen)
items.ships_in: the engine inside OkaySpace.exe, Tools/OkayEngine.exe and Tools/OkaySpacePlayer.exe (FBX import)

items.name: Simple DirectMedia Layer (SDL2)
items.copyright: not stated in the repository (SDL2.dll is a prebuilt binary taken from the SDL MinGW package)
items.ships_in: SDL2.dll at the top of the Windows distribution and in Tools/
items.note: Licence per docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. No licence file for it is in the repository.

items.name: Open Asset Import Library (Assimp)
items.copyright: not stated in the repository (downloaded at configure time, not vendored)
items.ships_in: linked into the Windows distribution (build-windows-dist.sh passes -DOKAY_USE_ASSIMP=ON)
items.note: Licence per docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. No licence file for it is in the repository.

items.name: libsodium
items.version: 1.0.20 (MinGW prebuilt used by release.yml, statically linked)
items.copyright: not stated in the repository (prebuilt package, not vendored)
items.ships_in: statically linked into the Windows programs when the release workflow sets OKAY_SODIUM_MINGW_PREFIX
items.note: Licence per docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. No licence file for it is in the repository.

items.name: TweetNaCl-derived code (C++ port of its ed25519 and SHA-512)
items.copyright: Bernstein et al. (named in the header of shared/AntiCheatCrypto.hpp)
items.licence: public domain (as the header of shared/AntiCheatCrypto.hpp states it)
items.no_text_needed: Public domain: the source states no licence text and none is required. Using it needs the owner's approval under CLAUDE.md rule 19a (see docs/provenance_audit.md, F2).
items.ships_in: the launcher and any build without libsodium and without OKAY_OWN_CRYPTO

items.name: DejaVu Sans (assets/fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf)
items.copyright: Copyright (c) 2003 by Bitstream, Inc. All Rights Reserved. DejaVu changes are in public domain. (The font's own name table also names glyphs from the Arev fonts, copyright 2006 Tavmjong Bah; that notice is NOT in the repository's licence file, see docs/asset_licences.md.)
items.licence: Bitstream Vera licence (as copied in the Debian copyright file)
items.ships_in: Assets/Fonts/ in the Windows distribution (starter font)
items.note: The licence file is the Debian package's copyright file. It has no entry for the Arev glyphs the font says it contains.

items.ships_in: embedded in the editor and launcher (shared/JetBrainsMonoFont.h) and the engine (shared/JetBrainsMonoFontOwn.h)

items.name: Roboto Medium (embedded)
